물.e: Builds 물고기 (fish) and 물냉면 (cold noodles in broth).
물.t: Restaurants serve water free, often self-service: 물은 셀프예요.

피.x: I fell on the street and my knee was bleeding.
피.t: Say 피가 나다 for bleeding: 코피가 나요 = My nose is bleeding.

끊다.m: to quit (smoking, drinking); to cut (off); to hang up (the phone)
끊다.x: My uncle completely quit smoking last year.
끊다.e: Covers cutting physical things and habits alike; 전화를 끊다 = to hang up.
끊다.t: Pronounced [끈타]; ending a call, 끊을게요 means 'I'll hang up now.'

뚱뚱하다.x: I've been eating a lot lately, so I've gotten a bit chubby.
뚱뚱하다.t: Calling someone 뚱뚱하다 is rude; 통통하다 'plump, chubby' is a gentler word.

떨어뜨리다.m: to drop; to lower (a price, a score)
떨어뜨리다.x: I dropped my phone on the subway and the screen cracked.
떨어뜨리다.e: Transitive partner of 떨어지다 'to fall': you make something fall.

열리다.m: to open, to be opened; to be held (an event)
열리다.x: The window opened by itself because of the wind.
열리다.e: Passive of 열다 'to open'; also 'bear fruit': 사과가 열리다.
열리다.t: Events are 'opened' in Korean: 축제가 열려요 = the festival is held.

깊다.m: to be deep; to be profound
깊다.x: This river is deep, so swimming in it is dangerous.
깊다.t: Pronounced [깁따]; 깊은 keeps the ㅍ sound: [기픈].

밖에.forms: Same form after any noun; ALWAYS followed by a negative: 밖에 없다, 밖에 안/못 …
밖에.ex: 지금 제 지갑에 천 원밖에 없어요.
밖에.x: I only have 1,000 won in my wallet right now.
밖에.e: Literally 'outside of' (밖 'outside' + 에): nothing beyond this amount.
밖에.t: Unlike 만, 밖에 must be followed by a negative: 하나밖에 없어요, never 하나밖에 있어요.

딱딱하다.m: hard, stiff; formal, rigid (mood or tone)
딱딱하다.x: The bread got hard because it's old.
딱딱하다.e: Also describes a stiff, formal mood: 딱딱한 분위기.

명령.x: Soldiers must follow their superior's orders.
명령.t: Pronounced [명녕] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

때때로.ex: 저는 때때로 혼자 영화를 보러 가요.
때때로.x: I sometimes go to the movies by myself.

거칠다.x: In winter the air is dry, so my hands get rough.
거칠다.e: Covers rough textures, rough waves, and rough or rude speech.

취하다.m: to get drunk, be drunk; to be intoxicated (by)
취하다.ex: 어제 술에 너무 취해서 기억이 안 나요.
취하다.x: I got so drunk yesterday that I can't remember anything.
취하다.t: Use the past form for being drunk now: 취했어요 'I'm drunk'. Also figurative: 분위기에 취하다 'be carried away by the mood'.

발차기.x: I learned kicks for the first time at the taekwondo school.
발차기.t: Basic taekwondo kicks: 앞차기 'front kick', 옆차기 'side kick', 돌려차기 'roundhouse kick'.

창작.ex: 그는 요즘 새 소설 창작에 집중하고 있어요.
창작.x: He is focusing on writing a new novel these days.

연주자.ex: 그 피아노 연주자는 어릴 때부터 상을 많이 받았어요.
연주자.x: That pianist has won many prizes since childhood.
연주자.t: Use 연주하다 for instruments; 악기를 치다/불다 is the everyday verb for specific instruments.

합창.ex: 졸업식에서 학생들이 다 같이 합창을 했어요.
합창.x: The students all sang together in a chorus at the graduation ceremony.

측정.x: The nurse measured my blood pressure.

정치적.x: That decision was made for political reasons.

막막하다.m: at a loss, hopeless, bleak (not knowing what to do)
막막하다.ex: 직장을 잃고 앞으로 어떻게 살아야 할지 막막했어요.
막막하다.x: After losing my job, I had no idea how I was going to get by.
막막하다.e: Literally 'vast and vast', like standing in an endless desert with no path.

좀처럼.forms: 좀처럼 + negative: 좀처럼 ~지 않다, 좀처럼 ~ㄹ 수 없다
좀처럼.x: My cold just won't go away.

반대로.m: on the contrary, conversely, the other way around
반대로.ex: 형은 조용해요. 반대로 동생은 아주 활발해요.
반대로.x: The older brother is quiet. Conversely, the younger one is very outgoing.

착용하다.ex: 공사장에서는 누구나 반드시 안전모를 착용해야 합니다.
착용하다.x: Everyone must wear a hard hat at construction sites.
착용하다.t: One formal verb covering 입다, 쓰다, 신다, 차다; common on signs and in announcements.

넉넉하다.x: We have plenty of time, so get ready slowly.

대통령제.x: Korea is a country that has adopted a presidential system.
대통령제.t: Pronounced [대통녕제] — ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

피고인.m: defendant (in a criminal case), the accused
피고인.x: The defendant claimed innocence in court.
피고인.t: 피고인 is used in criminal trials; in civil suits the defendant is 피고.

국제법.ex: 그 공격은 명백한 국제법 위반이라는 비판을 받았습니다.
국제법.x: The attack was criticized as a clear violation of international law.

도외시하다.m: to disregard, to ignore, to leave out of consideration
도외시하다.x: Development that disregards environmental issues is dangerous.
도외시하다.e: Literally 'regard as outside one's measure'; -시하다 = to regard as: 경시, 중요시.

뿌리내리다.m: to take root, to become established
뿌리내리다.ex: 민주주의가 이 사회에 뿌리내리기까지 오랜 시간이 걸렸어요.
뿌리내리다.x: It took a long time for democracy to take root in this society.
뿌리내리다.e: Built from 뿌리 'root' plus 내리다 'to put down' — literally putting down roots.

어김없이.ex: 그는 매일 아침 일곱 시에 어김없이 나타나요.
어김없이.x: He shows up at seven every morning without fail.
어김없이.e: From 어기다 'to break (a promise)' plus 없이 'without' — 'never breaking'.

창조성.ex: 예술가에게는 기술보다 창조성이 더 중요하다고 생각해요.
창조성.x: I think creativity matters more than technique for an artist.
창조성.t: 창의성 is the more common everyday word; 창조성 sounds a bit more formal or academic.

병명.ex: 검사를 해 봐야 정확한 병명을 알 수 있어요.
병명.x: We need to run tests to know the exact name of the illness.

공황.ex: 1929년의 대공황은 전 세계 경제에 큰 충격을 주었습니다.
공황.x: The Great Depression of 1929 dealt a huge blow to the world economy.
공황.e: Literally 'fear and panic', for markets and for people alike.
공황.t: Same word in psychology: 공황장애 'panic disorder', 공황 상태 'a state of panic'.

출연금.m: contributed funds, donated endowment (to a foundation or fund)
출연금.x: The foundation was established with funds contributed by the government and companies.
출연금.e: Literally 'money put out as a donation'; unrelated to 출연 'appearing on TV'.
출연금.t: Pronounced [추련금]; the ㄹ carries over into the next syllable.

치사율.x: This disease has a very high fatality rate.

수치화.x: Happiness and love are concepts that are hard to quantify.

우주항공.ex: 정부는 우주항공 분야에 투자를 확대하고 있습니다.
우주항공.x: The government is expanding investment in the aerospace sector.
우주항공.e: Literally 'outer space and sky-sailing' — the same words as 항공우주, reversed.
우주항공.t: Korea's space agency is 우주항공청, so this order is common in government and news contexts.

안무가.ex: 그 안무가는 유명 아이돌의 춤을 많이 만들었어요.
안무가.x: That choreographer created many dances for famous idols.
안무가.e: -가 = professional in a field: 안무가, 연출가, 작곡가.

흉흉하다.m: restless and uneasy, ominous (public mood); turbulent
흉흉하다.ex: 그 사건 이후 마을 분위기가 흉흉해졌어요.
흉흉하다.x: After that incident, the mood in the village became tense and uneasy.
흉흉하다.e: Originally waves surging noisily; now a restless, fearful public mood.
흉흉하다.t: Typical subjects: 민심 (public sentiment), 분위기 (mood), 소문 (rumors).
